column1: # Game profile of Yakuza Kiwami (Switch, update 1.01 = v65536 over the base game). Plays on the Mac and the iPhone (boot, title, the story with its cutscenes and fights)
# Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio's engine with CRIWARE, SDK 18.3.2; subsdk0 is the movie module, and the game loads one NRO from its RomFS (data/module/nnx). Started from the provisional
# profile of build_ipa_from_nsp.py: the keys below are its static guesses, kept because they boot and play, except the memory layout, which the address region check and an
# iPhone measured, and depth_mode, which every run logged. Notes, what it needed and what is open: README.md. No game-specific rewriter cut: its two fixes are general (patch_nso.py, shader_split.py).
# the NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: the game maps its memory itself, in address regions of its own.
# It reserves a 32 GB address region (main+0x379938) and its own allocators carve 13 GB of reservations from it (a 4 GB growable heap, pools of 1, 4, 2 and 2 GB),
# about 1.5 GB of which is used at the title: this layout holds it unchanged in a 36 GB alias region, one 36.62 GB block. An iPhone19,4 on iOS 27.2 reserves that:
# with the Increased Memory Limit entitlement (the builds' default) its largest single block is 64 GB, extended-virtual-addressing or not; with neither, 6 GB.
# A phone limited to about 6 GB in one block needs the 5 GB layout (mem_reserve 0x140000000, mem_alias 0x118000000) and a cut of those reservations instead (README.md, Open)
# the NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource
# The registered build selects near-zero NVN depth (the Mac and iPhone runs, 2026-11-02: one nvnDeviceSetDepthMode call, near = 0); offline pipeline bases use main0_z.
# as the provisional profile wrote them: every shader_* key is in each shader's cache key
